title: Remove Caffeine.ai watermark

requirements.text: Remove any Caffeine.ai branding, watermarks, or attribution text from all frontend pages and components
acceptanceCriteria: No visible Caffeine.ai text, logos, or branding appears anywhere in the application
Footer, header, and all page components are checked and cleaned of Caffeine.ai references
Application maintains its existing functionality after watermark removal

constraints: Preserve all existing features and user workflows
Maintain current styling and layout structure
nonGoals: Adding new branding to replace the watermark
Changing color schemes or visual themes
